title: Closed witness and coefficient-tower coherence for the normalized immersion comparison
statement: The normalized comparison for one coefficient arrow extends to ScalarSixExtensionData: the specified closed pushforward witness exists and the beta comparisons satisfy the canonical coefficient-tower equation. Uses [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces].

proof.text: Use the normalized immersion comparison and conjugate it with the published closed comparison isomorphisms. Functoriality and cancellation give the required closed witness equation.

The fixed module equivalence and its inverse are additive by internal-module operations transport. Their derived functors and the published extension are full, so their composite extension is full. A full extension with an invertible restriction is faithful under restriction on its essential image. Restrict the two sides of the beta tower equation. Normalization, naturality and the inverse of C.tower identify them; supported faithfulness proves their original equality.
